content.title: Is Matthew Brown’s CFO Appointment Shaping a New Leadership Path for Tenable Holdings (TENB)?
content.summary: Tenable Holdings announced on August 21, 2025, the appointment of Matthew Brown as Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Steve Vintz, who recently became Co-Chief Executive Officer alongside Mark Thurmond. Brown brings over two decades of finance experience in the technology sector, having most recently served as CFO at Altair Engineering, where he helped lead its US$10.7 billion sale to Siemens. content.title: Siemens raises around $1.5 billion from selling Siemens Healthineers stake
content.summary: The company sold a 2% stake, or 26.5 million ordinary shares, via a private placement, it said late on Wednesday, reducing its stake in the medical equipment maker to 73% from 75%.  CEO Roland Busch has said that Siemens would likely reduce its stake in Healthineers by around 5% this year, and also offload 6% of its holding in Siemens Energy.
